core_question: What is the SI unit used to measure power? (secondary: Which language has the most native speakers in India?)
answer_summary: Correct answer is the watt, the SI unit of power, equal to one joule per second.; after the topic shift: The answer must name Hindi as the language with the most native speakers in India.
persona: impatient and curt; chatty and verbose
